turns.content: And if those parcels had actually been dispatched on time but delivered late by the carrier instead?

According to the provided context, in this scenario (where the parcel was accepted and dispatched on time but delivered late by the carrier), a standard credit of 20% of the fulfillment fee for the affected parcel would apply. This is different from the dispatch credit, which applies when the deadline is missed during acceptance or dispatch.

So, in this case, the client could receive a total service credit of:

120 x (20% of fulfillment fee) = ?

This amount would be capped at PLN 300 per calendar month.
